## Valvoline Inc. to Participate in Morgan Stanley’s Global Consumer & Retail Conference


November 23, 2026


LEXINGTON, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance *,* today announced that the company will be participating in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference on Wednesday, December 2, at 2:15 p.m. ET.


A live audio webcast will be available on Valvoline Inc.’s investor relations website at[http://investors.valvoline.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valvoline.com%2F&esheet=54644875&newsitemid=20261123400591&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.valvoline.com&index=1&md5=1211eb2f797cee41e946870df4cacdff) . Following the live event, an archived version of the webcast will be available on the website.


**About Valvoline Inc.**


Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) delivers quick, easy, trusted service at more than 2,500 franchised and company-operated service centers across the United States and Canada. The Company completes more than 33 million services annually system-wide, from about 15-minute stay-in-your-car oil changes to a variety of manufacturer-recommended maintenance services such as wiper replacements and tire rotations. At Valvoline Inc., it all starts with our people, including the over 13,000 team members who are working to drive the full potential of our core business, deliver sustainable network growth and innovate to meet the evolving needs of our customers and the car parc. For more information, visit[vioc.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vioc.com%2F&esheet=54644875&newsitemid=20261123400591&lan=en-US&anchor=vioc.com.&index=2&md5=4234ffd5e45084dbc2f7e49a0a919404)
